items.title: New experts join Google’s AI & Economy team
items.summary: 这篇内容聚焦「AI 技术演进和可复用工程实践」。原文摘要显示：We are expanding our AI & Economy team with world-class academic advisors, fellows, and core internal researchers.
items.insightText: 先快速判断它是否包含可复用方法、架构或工程经验，再决定是否进入日报深读。

items.title: Fulcra Brings Universal Multiplayer to Any Agents You Choose
items.summary: 这篇内容聚焦「Agent Skill、Harness、工具调用和自动化研发」。原文摘要显示：The Instinct-to-Instinct model that is the talk of Silicon Valley presents too small a future for personal AI. With Fulcra’s multiplayer capabilities, people can get agent to agent collaboration without having to lock-i…
